svg.desc: KE-Texh TAMARAW Phase-1 SHELL. REV CONDITIONAL. PRELIMINARY — VERIFY ON VEHICLE — NOT LTO-CERTIFIED. R and D fabricator sheet. Gates unsigned = do not cut. NO-GO cut steel until gates.

g.text: KE-Texh / TAMARAW — PHASE-1 SHELL — R&D FABRICATOR PACK
PRELIMINARY — VERIFY ON VEHICLE — NOT LTO-CERTIFIED
GATES UNSIGNED = DO NOT CUT STEEL
R&D BUILD · RENDERS ARE NOT CUT GEOMETRY · NOT LTO
OAH ≤ 2500 = HATCH CLOSED. NO SECOND OAL.
Verify VIN and as-found tape before any cut.
Service plan: AC curb + gen bay
Wall ladder mounts, not a lift
AC curb provision — not the unit
GATES — UNSIGNED · NO-GO CUT UNTIL AS-FOUND + JAY GO + ENG + D-01…D-08
Bed, rails, cab roof, overhangs, VIN. Freeze on a shop traveler.
D-01 signed. No undirected drill into the bed rail or chassis rail.
D-01 and D-02. Placard stays blank until a post-weigh.
D-03 at the extension joint. FAIL-IF wet cabin, trapped water, wet glands.
D-04. FAIL-IF open cut with no seal, no rail, water in lounge, hatch open on road.
D-05. Roof access only. FAIL-IF used as a lift, or mounts loosen.
D-06. FAIL-IF trapped water under the tail, or wet glands at the bumper.
Section and weld size stay TBD until Eng GO. Do not invent them.
D-07 and D-08. Mounts only. Units are not cut Done. Parked-only gen run.
CLEAR H 1900–2000 IS A TARGET. IT IS NOT CLOSED BY SHELL EXT H ≈ 1830.
I-00 DRAWING INDEX, SoR, AND RELEASE STAMP
PRELIMINARY — VERIFY ON VEHICLE — NOT LTO-CERTIFIED
GATES: AS-FOUND TAPE · JAY GO RAIL DRILL · ENG TUBE/WELD · OUTRIGGERS+LEGS+WEIGH · HOSE · HATCH · GEN/AC PROVISION · D-01…D-08
REV CONDITIONAL · GATES UNSIGNED = DO NOT CUT · mm · 2026-09-23 · SHEET 1 OF 18
